summary:
NOVASTRIUM is an interactive project focused on exploring and understanding Mars through scientific data and digital technology. It provides a 3D visualization of the Red Planet, a geological atlas, information about important regions, and access to scientific resources from NASA.

The project addresses the challenge by making planetary science more accessible and helping users explore Martian geography, geological features, and scientific discoveries through an interactive experience.

NOVASTRIUM is important because understanding Mars is a key step toward future space exploration. By combining visualization, scientific information, and educational tools, the project aims to connect people with planetary research, encourage scientific curiosity, and support a better understanding of the challenges involved in exploring other worlds.
details: Project Details – NOVASTRIUM NOVASTRIUM is an interactive 3D platform designed to explore and understand the planet Mars. The project combines scientific information, geological data, and 3D visualization to make Mars exploration more accessible, educational, and engaging. The platform allows users to explore a three-dimensional representation of Mars, discover important geological regions, learn about features such as Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris, and Jezero Crater, and access scientific information about the planet. It also includes a geological atlas and an AI-based information module designed to help users understand Mars and its exploration. The main benefit of NOVASTRIUM is that it brings complex planetary science information together in one accessible environment. Instead of searching through multiple sources, users can interact with a visual platform that helps them understand the geography, geology, and scientific importance of different Martian regions. Our intended impact is to encourage scientific curiosity, support space education, and make planetary exploration more accessible, especially for students and people who are interested in astronomy and space science. We hope NOVASTRIUM can inspire more people to learn about Mars and the future of space exploration. The project was developed using JavaScript, React, Vite, Three.js, HTML, and CSS. We also used GitHub for version control and Vercel for deployment. The platform incorporates scientific references and publicly available planetary information to support its educational content. The creative aspect of NOVASTRIUM is the integration of interactive 3D visualization, geological exploration, and artificial intelligence in a single platform. Rather than presenting Mars as a collection of static images and text, NOVASTRIUM allows users to explore the planet in a more immersive and intuitive way. During development, our team considered scientific accuracy, accessibility, usability, educational value, performance, and the importance of presenting space science in a clear and engaging format. Our goal is to connect technology, science, and education while encouraging people to look beyond Earth.
